author: hdprajwal
abstract: Take screenshots on Wayland/Hyprland with grim + slurp — full screen, a chosen monitor, an interactive region, or the active/named window via hyprctl geometry — saved to a file or piped to wl-copy. Covers JPEG/PNG compression for feeding models and the physical-vs-logical pixel scaling gotcha. The eyes for visual computer use. Verified on CachyOS + Hyprland.
